caption_judgement: the caption is substantive, not a restatement of the figure: it names the read population per panel, the factor-carry median, the per-slice headline panel and the rule that no disagreeing pair is plotted, so no caption finding is recorded.

figure_reviewed.method: judged only the attached rendered PNG; no SVG was opened, read, searched or shown

findings.summary: The seven lever panels mark their two x positions only 'off' and 'on' and carry no x-axis label naming what is switched (report.py:401 writes the bare receipt arm names as ticks), so the figure alone does not say what an on-arm is for factor carry, lane drive or wall skip; the caption explains the read panels but does not name the toggle for those three, and a reader must go to the tables to decode the axis. It does not stop a reader reading any plotted value.

Each plotted point is one selected fresh process per arm and no spread, range or error indication is drawn; the caption discloses that no disagreeing pair contributes a point, but the figure therefore cannot show how much of a panel's difference sits inside the process spread, which is the margin the lever verdicts are adjudicated against. The wall comparison itself remains readable.

item_verdicts.data_ink: pass: the wall values are carried by two data series of markers and lines drawn at 2.6 pt and 3 pt, and nothing else competes for weight; no band, fill or reference line is drawn that the caption does not use.
item_verdicts.decoration: pass: white ground, no gridlines, no gradient or background fill, top and right spines hidden, and the single legend is frameless and sits in clear space above the panels.
item_verdicts.label_collision: pass: no label is clipped or overlapping; the ink bounding box is x 22-1379, y 16-681 inside a 1399x720 canvas, leaving at least 19 px clear on every edge, and no axis label, tick label or legend entry overlaps another or the plotted marks.
item_verdicts.legibility: pass: eight panels read at a glance at 1399x720; every y-axis label, tick label, x category and the Stream slice label is fully drawn and readable, and the four-panel-wide grid keeps the 13 pt labels clear of the plot area.
item_verdicts.table_form: pass: eight small multiples plot per-lever wall against arm, a relationship the reader compares within a panel across two widths; the numeric tables the reader needs for exact values are carried separately in the evidence fragment, so the image is not standing in for a table.
